      "text": "It sounds like you are playing **Terraria** and trying to combine **Calamity\u0027s Infernum Mod** with **Fargo\u0027s Souls Mod\u0027s Masochist Mode** (or Eternity Mode). If so, to answer your question: **No, the scaling is absolutely not correct.** \n\nYou have essentially combined two massive, complete difficulty overhauls that were never meant to be played at the same time. Here is why your Golem fight feels completely broken:\n\n**1. They are fundamentally incompatible**\nBoth Infernum and Fargo\u0027s Masochist Mode completely rewrite boss AIs, attack patterns, and stats. Because they both try to inject their own custom coding into the boss at the same time, the game usually glitches out. You are likely fighting a Golem that has its stats stacked multiplicatively, is firing overlapping bullet-hell patterns from *both* mods simultaneously, or has an AI loop that is entirely broken. \n\n**2. The developers explicitly warn against this**\nThe official *Fargo\u0027s Souls DLC* (the mod meant to make Calamity and Fargo\u0027s play nicely together) explicitly states on its workshop page that **Infernum is entirely incompatible**. Infernum\u0027s boss designs are incredibly polished, but they are strictly balanced around standard Calamity gear progression, not Fargo\u0027s. \n*   **If you want to play Masochist/Eternity Mode:** Disable the Infernum mod entirely. Make sure you have the \"Fargo\u0027s Souls DLC\" mod installed, which bridges Fargo\u0027s Souls with *base* Calamity (Death Mode), balancing the stats and items so it\u0027s actually a fair (but incredibly hard) fight.\n\nTurn one of them off, and Golem will instantly return to being a highly difficult—but actually mathematically possible and intentionally designed—boss fight!",

      "text": "First of all: **Huge respect.** The fact that you managed to beat *everything* up to Golem with both of those active is legitimately insane. You have been fighting mathematically broken, glitchy, overlapping AI nightmares for an entire playthrough and somehow won. You belong in a psych ward, but a very prestigious one. \n\nIt makes total sense why you don\u0027t want to stop now! You’ve come this far, so the \"sunk cost fallacy\" is hitting hard. But here is the reality of your situation, why Golem is the wall, and how you can approach this:\n\n### Why Golem is breaking you:\nIn normal Terraria, Golem is a joke. But in **Infernum**, Golem gets a complete overhaul with a custom enclosed arena and a highly choreographed, fast-paced rhythm fight. In **Masochist Mode**, Golem fires a ridiculous amount of bouncing fireballs, lasers, and boulders. \nBecause you have both on, you are trapped in Infernum\u0027s tiny custom arena while Masochist Mode floods that tiny box with screen-filling, unavoidable bullet-hell projectiles. There is no room to dodge because the game literally wasn\u0027t coded to give you room for both.\n\n### How to stop (The Reality Check):\nIf you need a reason to put this playthrough out of its misery, look to the future. If you somehow beat Golem, you are about to hit **Post-Moon Lord Calamity**. \n*   **Providence** and **The Devourer of Gods (DoG)** on Infernum are already considered some of the hardest bosses in Terraria modding history. \n*   If you combine Infernum DoG with Masochist Mode, there is a very high chance the sheer amount of projectile spam, overlapping segmented worm AIs, and conflicting code will literally just **crash your game** or drop your frame rate to 1 FPS. \n*   You aren\u0027t even fighting the game\u0027s difficulty anymore; you are fighting the game\u0027s engine. Consider Pre-Golem to be the \"True Ending\" of this cursed run. You beat the glitchy matrix.\n\n### ...But if you absolutely refuse to stop:\nIf the absolute madman inside you simply will not let you quit, you have to stop fighting fair. You cannot dodge attacks that are physically impossible to dodge. You must break the game back.\n\n1.  **Abuse Fargo\u0027s Accessories:** Fargo’s Souls items are notoriously overpowered. You need to start combining as many Enchantments into Forces as possible. Look for anything that gives you invincibility frames (i-frames), revives, or massive damage reduction. \n2.  **Cross Necklace / Star Veil:** If you are taking constant overlapping hits, maximizing your i-frames is the only way to survive the Golem arena blender.\n3.  **Rod of Discord / Normality Relocator:** You will need frame-perfect teleports to get out of the overlapping attack patterns. \n4.  **Lifesteal \u0026 Regen:** Since dodging is mathematically impossible at times, you have to out-heal the damage. Use Vampire Knives (if melee) or stack every single regen buff, potion, and accessory you can find.\n\nYou have my ultimate respect for making it this far. Whether you decide to finally toggle one of the modes off, or subject yourself to 400 more deaths trying to out-cheese a broken Golem, you\u0027ve already proven you are a Terraria god!",

      "finishReason": "STOP",
      "tokenCount": 736,
      "parts": [{
        "text": "First of all: **Huge respect.** The fact that you managed"
      }, {
        "text": " to beat *everything* up to Golem with both of those active is legitimately insane. You have been fighting mathematically broken"
      }, {
        "text": ", glitchy, overlapping AI nightmares for an entire playthrough and somehow won. You belong in a psych ward, but a"
      }, {
        "text": " very prestigious one. \n\nIt makes total sense why you don\u0027t want to stop now! You’ve come"
      }, {
        "text": " this far, so the \"sunk cost fallacy\" is hitting hard. But here is the reality of your situation, why G"
      }, {
        "text": "olem is the wall, and how you can approach this:\n\n### Why Golem is breaking you:\nIn normal"
      }, {
        "text": " Terraria, Golem is a joke. But in **Infernum**, Golem gets a complete overhaul with a custom"
      }, {
        "text": " enclosed arena and a highly choreographed, fast-paced rhythm fight. In **Masochist Mode**, Golem fires a"
      }, {
        "text": " ridiculous amount of bouncing fireballs, lasers, and boulders. \nBecause you have both on, you are trapped in Infernum\u0027"
      }, {
        "text": "s tiny custom arena while Masochist Mode floods that tiny box with screen-filling, unavoidable bullet-hell projectiles. There"
      }, {
        "text": " is no room to dodge because the game literally wasn\u0027t coded to give you room for both.\n\n### How to stop ("
      }, {
        "text": "The Reality Check):\nIf you need a reason to put this playthrough out of its misery, look to the future. If"
      }, {
        "text": " you somehow beat Golem, you are about to hit **Post-Moon Lord Calamity**. \n*   **Providence"
      }, {
        "text": "** and **The Devourer of Gods (DoG)** on Infernum are already considered some of the hardest bosses"
      }, {
        "text": " in Terraria modding history. \n*   If you combine Infernum DoG with Masochist Mode, there"
      }, {
        "text": " is a very high chance the sheer amount of projectile spam, overlapping segmented worm AIs, and conflicting code will literally just"
      }, {
        "text": " **crash your game** or drop your frame rate to 1 FPS. \n*   You aren\u0027t even fighting"
      }, {
        "text": " the game\u0027s difficulty anymore; you are fighting the game\u0027s engine. Consider Pre-Golem to be the \""
      }, {
        "text": "True Ending\" of this cursed run. You beat the glitchy matrix.\n\n### ...But if you absolutely refuse to stop:"
      }, {
        "text": "\nIf the absolute madman inside you simply will not let you quit, you have to stop fighting fair. You cannot"
      }, {
        "text": " dodge attacks that are physically impossible to dodge. You must break the game back.\n\n1.  **Abuse Fargo\u0027s Accessories"
      }, {
        "text": ":** Fargo’s Souls items are notoriously overpowered. You need to start combining as many Enchantments into Forces as possible."
      }, {
        "text": " Look for anything that gives you invincibility frames (i-frames), revives, or massive damage reduction. \n2."
      }, {
        "text": "  **Cross Necklace / Star Veil:** If you are taking constant overlapping hits, maximizing your i-frames is the only way to"
      }, {
        "text": " survive the Golem arena blender.\n3.  **Rod of Discord / Normality Relocator:** You will"
      }, {
        "text": " need frame-perfect teleports to get out of the overlapping attack patterns. \n4.  **Lifesteal"
      }, {
        "text": " \u0026 Regen:** Since dodging is mathematically impossible at times, you have to out-heal the damage. Use Vampire Knives (if melee"
      }, {
        "text": ") or stack every single regen buff, potion, and accessory you can find.\n\nYou have my ultimate respect for making it"
      }, {
        "text": " this far. Whether you decide to finally toggle one of the modes off, or subject yourself to 400 more deaths"
      }, {
        "text": " trying to out-cheese a broken Golem, you\u0027ve already proven you are a Terraria god!"
      }, {
        "text": "",
        "thoughtSignature": ""
      }]
    }],
